dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, gradual 2D geometric narrowing from the anterior mid-body towards the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the primary dorsal surface with minimal tonal variation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single prominent vertical linear dark mark along the central dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Deep, shadow-casting longitudinal groove along the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced longitudinal linear indentation or healed trauma mark centered on the dorsal ridge, exhibiting high contrast and shadow depth.
